hmlr_currentness.rule: Use the current July 2026 monthly INSPIRE publication; exact HMLR IDs may be accepted only from real current GML/previous verified exact polygon evidence, never from approximate address inference.

hmlr_native_bng.rule: Keep exact containment and raster masking in native British National Grid/EPSG:27700. HMLR warns web reprojection may shift features by up to 15m.

national_lidar_schema.rule: Exact target lineage must be populated only from returned National_LIDAR_Programme_Index_Catalogue fields dtm_fn, tilename, sd_flown, ed_flown, surveys, resolution, year and latest.

timestamped_schema.rule: Exact time-stamped lineage must read dtm_name, ostilename, sdflown, edflown, resolution, transform, geoid and latest from the exact intersecting feature.

wcs_raw_pixel.rule: Composite DTM 1m WCS 2.0.1 is a raw-pixel route; numeric elevation/statistics require real DescribeCoverage/GetCoverage bytes and NoData exclusion.

terrain50_currentness.rule: OS Terrain 50 July 2026 OpenData is current secondary corroboration; real archive members are still required before any target crosscheck.

numeric_claim.rule: No elevation, height difference, quartile, confidence or uncertainty is written until exact target lineage and real raster/archive bytes are observed.

transport_fail_closed.rule: Safe-open restrictions, DNS failure and XML-client incompatibility are transport/client failures, not evidence that target data is absent.
